title: AdvancedChatLog Reforged
description: View and search your full, persistent chat history for AdvancedChat. Refurbished Minecraft 26.x version of DarkKronicle AdvancedChatLog.
body:
# AdvancedChatLog Reforged

AdvancedChatLog lets you view and search your chat history, beyond what Minecraft normally keeps.

> **Unofficial fork.** This is a community-maintained continuation of DarkKronicle's *AdvancedChat* suite (which its author archived), updated to **Minecraft 26.1 and 26.2** (Java 25). It is **not affiliated with, nor endorsed by, DarkKronicle**, and is distributed under the original project's MPL-2.0 license.

## Features

- Scrollable history beyond the vanilla 100-line limit
- Search with regex, literal or case-insensitive matching
- Optional persistence across sessions

## Requirements

- Minecraft **26.1.x** or **26.2** on **Java 25**
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) 0.19+, [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), [MaLiLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/malilib) (sakura-ryoko 26.x builds)
- [AdvancedChatCore Reforged](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancedchatcore-reforged)

## Source & license

[GitHub](https://github.com/flyingfinger1/AdvancedChatLog) · MPL-2.0 · original mod by DarkKronicle
